subject: Re: Wholesale quote follow up
body:
Good morning,

Thank you for your follow up. I had put your first email aside because we were in the middle of stock taking, and honestly I forgot about it until your reminder landed. We buy fittings and hoses from three suppliers at the moment and our main frustration is the lead time, which has crept up from 5 days to nearly 3 weeks. If you can truly turn around standard orders in 7 days then we would very much like to test you with a trial order. We could start with something modest, say 15 SKUs, and see how the delivery performance looks over two months. Please send the price list for the standard range, the terms of trade and the name of the person who would be our account contact. I am also copying our finance controller so he can set you up as a vendor.

Best regards,
Harold Brandt
Procurement Lead

subject: Re: Reply to your email
body: ok so i read it and honestly i am not sure what you are selling. is it a website? an app? a person? my wife says its probably a scam but my cousin said you guys helped his plumbing business. we are a small family run farm shop and we sell eggs honey and some veg and i do all the orders on paper. i can use a phone but not very good with computers. so before anything else can you just tell me in simple words what it does and what it would cost a month. if it is more than 50 pounds forget it. thanks

subject: Re: Equipment financing
body:
Dear Sam,

Thank you for your detailed message and for the helpful comparison you attached. Our board reviewed the matter at its last meeting and concluded that, while the proposal has merit, we are not in a position to take on additional commitments until the capital plan for next year has been approved. That process is scheduled to complete in the second half of January. We would welcome the opportunity to revisit the conversation at that time. In the meantime, please do not hesitate to send any updated materials.

Yours sincerely,
Catherine Ng
Chair, Finance Committee

subject: Re: Pro bono intake tool
body: Hello. I am writing from the Eastside Food Pantry. I am sorry to say that we do not handle legal intake at all, we are a food charity. I think your message was meant for the Eastside Legal Aid Society, which is in a different building down the road (not affiliated with us). Their director is a lady called Ruth Abara. I do not have her email but their number is on Google. Good luck, the tool sounds worthwhile.

subject: Re: Re: Heads up on conveyor parts
body: Look, I've been polite so far. I've deleted the first two emails, I ignored the third, and now there's a fourth. I run a factory floor, I have no time for this nonsense, and I definitely did not sign up for your newsletter. I will say it plain. Take me off. Stop emailing this address. If I see another one I'm going to mark you as spam and tell the rest of the industry group to block you as well.

subject: Re: licensing question
body:
Counsel's note.

Before my client can consider the proposal, we require clarification on the following matters: (a) the governing law and venue of the master agreement; (b) whether the supplier carries professional indemnity cover and in what amount; (c) the retention period for any personal data processed; and (d) whether any part of the service is performed outside the European Economic Area. Please respond in writing within ten business days.

Regards,
S. Pelham
